title: Crash tech moved from Wright Patterson to private hands

tellings.quote: Let's just speculate for a second and say a UFO crashed over here and it was brought to Wright Patterson.

plain: The idea here is that wreckage from a crashed UFO could have been taken to Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio, and that the technology was later passed into private hands. A guest named Scott Ramsey offers it to Michels as openly speculative: "Let's just speculate for a second and say a UFO crashed over here and it was brought to Wright Patterson."
